senses.gloss:
ऋच् ऋच्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To shine, ved.
 2. i. 1, and † i. 6, Par. To praise, ved.
 3. To honour, Man. 3, 93; anomal. absol. अर्च्य, Man. 1, 4.
 --Caus. अर्चय, To honour, Man. 2, 181.
 अर्चित, Respectfully bestowed, Man. 4, 235.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, To honour, Man. 8, 391.
 --With समभि सम्-अभि, To honour, Yājñ. i. 226; to adore, 2, 112.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To salute in turn, Rām. 2, 71, 31.
 2. To salute one by one, MBh. 1, 7211.
 --With सम् सम्, To adore, Rām. 2, 3, 48; to honour, MBh. 3, 11090 (properly 10190).

ऋच् ऋच्, f.
 1. A verse or text of the Vedas, Man. 11, 142.
 2. The Ṛgveda, Man. 1, 23.
 --Comp.
